Both cells contain a nucleus, which controls all cell activities. {GAP_1} Only the plant cell has a cell wall, which provides rigid support. {GAP_2} The large central vacuole visible in [img:1] is absent from the animal cell. {GAP_3}

The graph in [img:1] shows the results of an experiment investigating the effect of light intensity on the rate of photosynthesis.

As light intensity increases from 0 to point A on [img:1], the rate of photosynthesis rises steadily. {GAP_1} Between points A and B, the curve begins to level off. {GAP_2} Beyond point B, increasing light intensity has no further effect on the rate. {GAP_3}
sentences: This is because light is the limiting factor at low intensities — more photons means more reactions.|At this stage, another factor such as CO₂ concentration or temperature is becoming the limiting factor.|The process has reached its maximum rate and is now limited by the rate of the Calvin cycle.
